# Quiz Trail

> Quiz Trail is a free, open-source practice application for Google Cloud AI certifications. PMLE practice is available; the certification catalog shows current Professional Agentic Architect availability.

Quiz Trail provides 400+ carefully curated single-choice and multiple-choice practice questions with answer explanations, references, progress tracking, review queues, and section-level insights. It is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

## Public pages

- [Quiz Trail certification catalog](https://quiz-trail.web.app/): Choose a certification. See the current availability of PMLE and Professional Agentic Architect.
- [Interactive PMLE practice](https://quiz-trail.web.app/practice/): Sign in with Google for the complete question bank and saved progress across devices.
- [10 free PMLE sample questions](https://quiz-trail.web.app/sample-questions/): Preview representative questions, answers, explanations, and official references without signing in.
- [10 free PAA sample questions](https://quiz-trail.web.app/agentic-ai/sample-questions/): Public static examples with answers, explanations, and references. Full PAA access follows the availability shown in the catalog.
- [FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/faq/): Sign-in, saved progress, account data, and shared question comments.
- [PMLE FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/pmle/faq/): PMLE question-bank coverage, study approach, and official exam resources.
- [PAA FAQ](https://quiz-trail.web.app/agentic-ai/faq/): Public information about Professional Agentic Architect practice and access requirements.
- [Quiz Trail source code](https://github.com/Ameenota/quiz-trail): Review the open-source project or report an issue.
- [Official Google Cloud certification page](https://cloud.google.com/learn/certification/machine-learning-engineer): Check current certification details and requirements from Google Cloud.

## Access and content notes

- Google sign-in is required for interactive practice, progress summaries, saved progress, and shared question comments. Public sample questions and FAQs remain available without an account.
- The practice material is original and curated for learning. It is not an exam dump and does not claim to contain real certification exam questions.
- Learners should use the official Google Cloud certification page and exam guide as the final source for current exam requirements.

- Full interactive Professional Agentic Architect practice requires Google sign-in and may be limited to preview accounts until release; its ten static sample questions are public. PMLE progress and URLs remain unchanged.

- Progress summaries are certification-specific: `/practice/?view=summary` for PMLE and `/practice/?cert=agentic-ai&view=summary` for PAA. The PAA summary follows the same access requirements as PAA practice.
